premise: I cashed out my late husband’s $112,000 life-insurance policy after twenty-seven years as a school custodian to buy and restore a fleet of vintage Airstream trailers for a family glamping business with my stepson, notarizing a 50% share and a lifetime of free summer weekends for my grandkids, but when a boutique hotel group offered $620,000 for the trailers and booking contracts he forged a title transfer, sold the fleet, and mailed me a $3,900 'propane' check; I recovered the original partnership paperwork from inside a 1958 Overlander’s propane locker, voided the sale, and now run 'Hitch of Betrayal Glamping,' where he re-seams trailer cushions in coveralls that say 'Riveted by Lies' and every booking confirmation prints his fraud-docket number.
